content.text: From that menu, gado-gado is your vegetarian one — it's a salad of vegetables with peanut sauce, though I can't promise the kitchen doesn't sneak in shrimp paste or a boiled egg. Nasi goreng and sate ayam both usually carry meat, so I'd ask before ordering those. Want me to check a place nearby that does it clearly veggie?
